goal: 发布 pi-router 0.5.4，包含多会话生命周期隔离、startup discovery 安全和 Pi 0.85.0 兼容验证

summary.title: Release pi-router 0.5.4
summary.what: Bumped package and lockfile versions to 0.5.4, finalized the changelog section, created and pushed the v0.5.4 tag, published the public npm package, and created the GitHub Release.
summary.why: Ship the verified multi-session lifecycle isolation, duplicate discovery protection, runtime-only startup model support, and Pi 0.85.0 compatibility fixes as a patch release.
summary.user_goal: 发布 pi-router 0.5.4，包含多会话生命周期隔离、startup discovery 安全和 Pi 0.85.0 兼容验证

decisions.rationale: The changes fix lifecycle and startup discovery regressions without intentionally breaking the public API.

review_notes: System Pi 0.85.0 verification passed: typecheck, 136/136 tests, build, verify.sh, git diff --check, and package dry run.
npm latest resolves to 0.5.4; tag v0.5.4 and origin/master resolve to release commit 3a188d92dd99c76bbcef706056002d787aeaf42a.
The one-time npm token was used only through a chmod-600 temporary userconfig and that file was removed after publication.

architectural_claims: Release metadata only; implementation is inherited from b4cece95e403a78f70aa151d6dd2e449be16565c.
behavioral_changes: npm consumers installing latest now receive pi-router 0.5.4.

data_model_changes.migration_notes: Patch release; no configuration migration required.

security_implications: Temporary npm credentials were deleted after publication.
